title: vocab
description: A vocabulary described as entities: a `_comp` per component, a `_prop` per property, a `_before` edge per kind a kind sorts before. Each wears `doc` for its name and its description. The names start with `_`, which no authored name can.

_comp.description: a component a vocabulary declares: one aspect an entity carries. Its doc.title is its name, its doc.body its description

name.description: the name a bundle writes it under

package.description: the package whose vocabulary declares it

kind.description: true = it names a display kind

wire.description: false = clients read it and never write it

bare.description: false = its properties are reached by their qualified names only

sync.description: who is told about a write to it

durable.description: how long one of its values lives: forever, connection, or a duration

pace.description: how often a writer's value is taken, as a duration

search.description: the text its entities are found by, as comp.prop names of another component

identity.description: the properties, in order, its entities' ids are derived from

unique.description: the property lists no two of its rows share

constraints.description: numeric bounds over a whole row

keywords.description: every other keyword its entry says, as written: another package's (prefix, by_name, edge) and JSON Schema's own

_prop.description: a property of a component. Its doc.title is comp.prop, its doc.body its description

ord.description: its position among the properties its entry declares, from 0

package.description: the package whose vocabulary declares it: the component's own, or one that extends it

type.description: the JSON type it holds, or a union of them: string, number, integer, boolean, object, array

format.description: what a string or number means: date-time, uri, query, json, priority

enum.description: the closed set of values it holds

const.description: the one value it may hold

default.description: what a row holds when its writer supplied nothing; {"now": true} is the clock

ref.description: the component a reference names; entity is any

death.description: what deleting the referenced entity does to this one

stamped.description: true = the server owns it: clients read it, never write it

reads.description: on a computed property, the components on other entities it reads

bare.description: false = reached by its qualified name only

unique.description: true = no two rows share it

identity.description: true = its entity's id is derived from it

validate.description: true = a write is checked against its whole JSON Schema

aliases.description: input forms that resolve to an enum member

properties.description: the declared structure of an object value, as written

items.description: the declared structure of an array's elements, as written

keywords.description: every other keyword it says, as written: another package's (store) and JSON Schema's own (minLength, maximum)

_before.description: the edge from a kind to a kind it sorts before; edge.ord keeps the order its entry lists them in
